hierarchy-bundles.visual_critic_note: Clean card UI and warm orange palette show some design intent, but the circle pack is clipped at the bottom viewport edge and the competing blue active-button vs green accent creates color disharmony in the controls.
hierarchy-bundles.encoding_integrity_note: Size encoding correctly uses scaleSqrt for both force-layout radiusScale and sunburst y_scale; data-driven domains via d3.extent; key functions present on all data joins — no quantitative axes to truncate, so baseline rules are moot for this topology visualization.
hierarchy-bundles.stress_test_note: The tension slider fires redrawLinks() on every input event with no RAF/debounce (300+ paths redrawn per frame), and switching to Force layout mid-transition starts the force simulation tick immediately without interrupting the concurrent 750ms shape-morph transition, causing the simulation and transition to fight over node positions.
hierarchy-bundles.cognitive_load_note: Single-view layout switching keeps working memory load low, but edge bundles overlaid on the circle pack create a dense central tangle that obscures node structure — the 200-node count and 10-color Tableau palette are manageable individually, but the bundled lines cutting through packed circles make it hard to trace connections without interaction.
